method: Closed-form beam, torsion and statics screens with base-metal minimum properties. These screens precede, and do not replace, the native structural-route review.

rulesCheck.notInArtifact: rules-v0.json and its register carry no in-match height limit and no direction-specific extension rules. Do not infer them from a historical game; record them in the rule register if the owner adds them.

gearbox.decision: Gearbox protection (owner decision): fit a mandatory 1/2 in hex friction slip clutch set between the worst normal-duty torque and the output-stage rating, OR show a documented output-stage capacity of at least 26 N m (F3 with an ideal inhibit). r3 records both routes and the latency condition on the second
gearbox.formula: (30 - 1.4) A x 0.00984 N m/A x 54.83 (the cap the controller can hold in any stall, including the feed peak)

clutchRoute.placement: between REV-41-1620 and the port drive hex; the gearbox plate stands off outboard by the clutch length with the six-hole pattern kept. Needs its own drive checked placement (open)
clutchRoute.basis: never slips at the 15.4 N m normal-duty cap; caps the gearbox at <= 18 N m in F1-F3 and B1 whatever the inhibit latency or rotor inertia

capacityRoute.validOnlyIf: measured inhibit trip-to-neutral latency <= 1.46 ms (F3 travel from -3.5 deg to the pad); at 5 ms the worst fault reaches 41.0 N m

gearbox.supplierRating: REV UltraPlanetary load ratings (docs.revrobotics.com/rev-crossover-products/ultraplanetary/load-ratings) as recorded in the FRC wiki, wiki/authored/frc/2025-poc/reference/reefscape-grip-slide-drive-sources.md:65: 40 N m output-stage FAILURE, reduced by shock and cantilever loads. A failure value, not a working rating
gearbox.verdict: The published 40 N m is a failure value. It is above the 26 N m ideal-inhibit demand but below the 41.0 N m late-inhibit demand, so the clutch route governs until the latency is measured. The roster carries the clutch as required
gearbox.currentCap: unchanged at 30 A (lowering it breaks the 29.62 A feed peak)
gearbox.idleMode: COAST. Brake mode shorts the windings at the inhibit and raises the F3 gearbox torque to 41.5 N m (rotor inertia 3e-06 kg m2); coast is also the unpowered state the replay passes
gearbox.rotorInertiaSource: OPEN: no published NEO 550 rotor inertia is held in the project records or the wiki. 3e-6 kg m2 is an assumption; pan-stop-study-04 driveFault shows the post-cut gearbox torque scales with it (x2, x3). The slip clutch bounds the gearbox regardless

cradleCheck.faultCasesIncluded: r3 designs the cradles for F3 (inhibit late, clutch-limited drive reaction), B1 front bumper strike and the rear-strike stow-pad load
cradleCheck.limits: Pinned and fixed end bounds; torsion fixed at both ends; combined corner stress with von Mises. End-clip bolts, wall bearing and clip prying are screened below and remain open for the native structural route.

stowStopStiffness.replayTolerance: pan-stop-study F4/F6 passed at 2x softer; inside 2x keeps the study's result. Re-replay only if the measured series stiffness is softer than 3000 N m/rad

rejectedLipPatch.basis: 2 mm 5052 lip 65 mm wide loaded 90 mm above the root: the study's original patch would make the stop about 24x softer, which is why the stop moved to the cheek lug

carrierAndStruts.axialLocation: thrust on the starboard carrier only; the port bearing floats axially on the drive hex
carrierAndStruts.basis: carrier pinned at its landings, propped by two knee struts at Z=560; without struts the 685 N axial load at 82.6 mm puts about 970 MPa into a 1/8 in landing clip

cheekLadder.design: r2 riveted sheet-and-tube ladder: 1/8 in 6061-T6 skin, 3/4 x 3/4 x 1/16 in upper and lower stringers, three 3/4 x 3/4 x 1/8 in webs, a socket post stack of three waterjet plates and a 3/16 in pivot bulkhead under the floor, tied by a 1 x 1 x 1/4 in end clip. No welds and no monolith; every part is a 2D waterjet or router cut or a saw cut and drill, except the bent lip root clip (hand brake, fabrication-plan.json)
cheekLadder.loadLocation: pan-duty-summary/pan-shop-plan impacts: panImpact at pan-local (u=-16, w=120), i.e. at the socket post; the 685 N moving-guide force is applied at w=110 on the post line (design) and at the front end (sensitivity)

oneWebCarriesAll.rootDetail: the web root is the rivet line in the skin-side wall (extrusion corner radius about 1.6 mm); Kt 2.5 at the rivet holes

fatigue.basis: R=0 pulsating guide load, notch factor from Kt 2.5 with q 0.8, modified Goodman. The 200 MPa is a smooth-specimen fully reversed strength at about 1e4 cycles (conservative for the 1.6e3-cycle life), not an endurance limit; aluminium has none
fatigue.KtSource: Kt 2.5 at a rivet hole in the web tube wall: textbook basis, Pilkey and Pilkey, Peterson's Stress Concentration Factors (3rd ed., Wiley 2008), chapter 4, finite-width plate with a central circular hole in tension (net-section Kt about 2.2-2.6 for d/W 0.1-0.4). Not captured in the project wiki; d/W here is about 0.25

rootMomentPath.path: cheek top -> skin and upper stringer -> socket post plate stack (4 x #10-32 FHCS in rows Z 595/668) -> post root -> 1 x 1 x 1/4 in end clip (3 x #10-32 SHCS through leg B and the skin into the post inner plate; 3 x #10-32 SHCS through leg A and the bulkhead with locknuts) -> pivot bulkhead -> opposite post; the pan-level moment closes as a +/-193 N couple at the two bearings

joint.design: 1 x 1 x 1/4 in 6061-T6 angle, 75 mm (Z 502..577), bolted through both legs

legA.nuts: nylon-insert locknuts on the bulkhead forward face (open, reachable from below the floor)

postStack.note: three waterjet plates tied by 3 x #10-32 FHCS; the non-composite value governs

joint.governing: leg B bending at the screws
joint.supersedes: r2 clip: 2 x 3/16 in rivets in shear (margin -0.35 to -0.54), a #10 flat head that did not fit beside the leg, and a row 1 mm from the clip end

offPostSensitivity.loadAt: cheek top front end (X 545, Z 690); lower stringer split at the post

pathC.member: cheek torsion (two 3/4 x 1/16 in stringer tubes + skin) about the floor-held lower edge, back to the post

floorClips.nearLoad: clips 470 and 530 on the loaded side
floorClips.returnAtPost: clips 140 and 260 on both cheeks plus the root clips, about F_C / 8 each

correctedScreen.note: the r2 package I (37,918 mm4) was wrong; both stringers give 29,106 mm4 and 127 MPa, but the lower stringer is split at the post so only path A's upper-stringer section is continuous

offPostSensitivity.note: Elastic share by stiffness; the floor diaphragm itself is far from critical. Contact logs place the guide impacts at the post; the replay must still report contact positions

floorClips.basis: The 1/16 in clips are far more flexible in rotation than the post and bulkhead path, so they carry the diaphragm shear plus at most about 5 % of the root moment. Their rivets are checked in tension with an AISC T-stub prying factor

rivetSpec.heads: dome heads outside the pipe footprint; dimpled-sheet countersunk rivets where flush is needed (no knife-edge countersink in 2 mm sheet)

materials.cheek: 6061-T6 plate and tube, base metal (no heat input)

skinPanel.model: clamped circular panel a=40 mm, patch r0=15 mm (Roark)

stopLugBlock.designBasis: max(stow pad peak 51 N, rear bumper strike 296 N) x 2 dynamic; r2 used 102 N
stopLugBlock.design: waterjet stack: 7/8 in striking plate, the 1/8 in skin lobe and a 1/2 in outboard plate, tied by 2 x #10-32 FHCS into the tapped outboard plate and 2 x 4 mm steel dowels through all three

stowStopBracket.source: OPEN: no sourced #10-32 rivet-nut pull-out rating in 1/16 in 6061-T6 is held in the project records or the wiki. 1500 N is a procurement requirement; the selected SKU's published value must meet it before release

aftBolt.nut: nylon-insert locknut under the keeper (open below the cradle)

cradleFrontWall.note: beam heel on the cradle front-top corner, carried by the 1/16 in front wall in bearing; crippling to be confirmed in the native structural route

candidate.classOf: music-wire torsion spring, ASTM A228, made to print or the nearest catalog part within +/-10 % rate
candidate.windDirection: wound so that closing the pan winds the spring (diameter reduces under load)
candidate.allowable: 0.78 MTS static; 0.6 MTS light cyclic service; this design is at the ratio above
candidate.procurementNote: No supplier catalog lookup was performed for this revision. Procurement must match the rate, ID, leg geometry and wind, or order made to print.

softStop.replayLawUnchanged: 4050 N m/rad and 12.8 N m s/rad at -5 deg, 90 mm lever: the 18 mm pad keeps 250 N/mm per pad, so the replay law is unchanged
softStop.controlsRequirement: Required in every mode: an absolute-encoder soft limit at -2 deg, plus an opening-direction drive inhibit at -3.5 deg on the pan controller's reverse-limit input, independent of the roboRIO. The inhibit zeroes opening output only, never cuts closing output and never latches. Idle mode coast. Trip-to-neutral <= 5 ms measured on the bench. The soft stop, its beam, the stow lug and the gearbox protection are sized for F2/F3 with the inhibit 5 ms late and for the bumper strike; inspect the pads after any fault event
softStop.sweepNote: geometry.json sweeps the moving pan from -9 to 70.1 deg, which covers the fault envelope and the stow peak overtravel

driveInhibit.direction: opening only (theta decreasing); closing output always allowed; non-latching (re-arms as soon as the cam leaves the switch)
driveInhibit.evidence: pan-stop-study-04: the directional inhibit never trips in normal running (results identical to the no-cut control C4); a non-directional cut fails 6 of 12 resets (fullCutControl)

hardware.sensor: snap-action roller-lever limit switch (SPDT, normally-closed wiring to the controller reverse-limit input so an open lead also inhibits opening)
hardware.flag: Port reverse-limit cam: 1/8 in waterjet plate on the port drive hex, base radius 20 mm, lobe 23.5 mm over pan theta -14..-3.5 deg with 2 deg ramps
hardware.seat: Seat pan reverse-limit switch on the port bearing carrier outboard face (geometry.json deferredSeats); roller at world angle -90 deg about the pivot
hardware.controller: REV SPARK MAX data port (docs.revrobotics.com/brushless/spark-max/specs/data-port) as recorded in wiki/authored/frc/reference/limit-sensor-interface-boundaries.md:25: forward/reverse limit inputs neutralize output in the affected direction only and allow the opposite direction. Documented behaviour, not an executed firmware test; latency is not published there

travel.note: the switch operating point must sit inside the 3.5 mm rise; the lobe holds it operated past the -9 deg joint limit, so overtravel cannot release it

responseTime.basis: trip-to-neutral must be bench-measured (switch operate time plus controller limit response). The structure and the clutch are sized with the inhibit acting 5 ms late, so the inhibit is credited only for slow faults such as F1

driveInhibit.idleMode: coast (brake mode raises the F3 gearbox torque; see gearbox.idleMode)

fastenerJoints.basis: #10-32 alloy SHCS/FHCS: 12.5 kN tension, 7.5 kN single shear. Bearing allowable is 1.5 x 120 MPa on the thinnest wall. Every screw that lands in a closed 1/16 in tube wall goes into a #10-32 blind rivet nut (roster rows), never a locknut; nuts are used only where the far side is open (bulkhead clip leg A, soft-stop keeper)

rivetNut.article: #10-32 aluminium or steel flanged blind rivet nut, 0.5-2.0 mm grip, for a 1/16 in 6061-T6 wall
rivetNut.source: OPEN: no sourced #10-32 rivet-nut pull-out rating in 1/16 in 6061-T6 is held in the project records or the wiki. 1500 N is a procurement requirement; the selected SKU's published value must meet it before release

landingClips.host: 1 into the tapped carrier or gearbox plate, 1 into a rivet nut in the cradle top wall

trussMemberForces.method: pin-jointed side truss (members 0-5 of inset-pan-truss layout) loaded by the cradle end shares and the starboard strut feet for every cradle case above

trussNodes.design: plugged butt node: a 12.7 mm plug fitted to the member bore, four 3/16 in blind rivets (two through each of two opposite walls), one #10-32 SHCS down through the stringer bottom wall (access hole in the top wall)
trussNodes.source: trussMemberForces (current r2 cases; replaces the stale inset-pan-truss 2x-duty 2418 N)
trussNodes.compression: bears on the stringer underside through the member end face
trussNodes.copedMembers: members 1/3/5 are coped onto members 0/2 below Z 468. Their gussets go on the rear X faces below the stringer, outside the cradle envelope (cradle bottom Z 471.975)
